blocks.html: Through the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program of Robinsons Malls, The Gift of Change (TGOC) children who are afflicted with cancer from the PGH cancer ward and the abandoned ones currently house in Manila Boystown Complex were treated at Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Galleria. This post-Valentine event, was TGOC’s way of capping the Love Month with different activities for the children. With the help of Daiso, Tom’s World, Kenny Rogers, Jollibee, the beneficiaries had a fun-filled mall visit. Young superstars, Baily May and Ylona Garcia, more popularly known as Bailona, performed and shared their time with beneficiaries. Kids went home with goodie bags and comfort Love pillows from Robinsons Malls.
